static_traits.name: Chen Mingze
static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother; close relationship with mother, who is an important supporter
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy in the past; no similar problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, capable of self-reflection, fairly cooperative, neutral tone, can describe events and emotions specifically

basic_info.main_problem: Self-labeling of 'I am irresponsible, I am lazy' arising from being late to last week's book club; this pattern appears frequently with small mistakes, undermining self-esteem and affecting daily life.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to recognize and change the pattern of self-labeling and personalization around small mistakes under professional guidance, improving self-esteem and mental health.

core_beliefs: I am a lazy and irresponsible person

special_situations.event: Arriving late to last week's book club
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, it means I am a lazy and irresponsible person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Correcting mistakes through self-reflection and positive self-talk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too irresponsible; I am lazy

special_situations.event: Forgetting to send an email at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I forget a task, others will think I do not care, and that I am an unreliable person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to stay busy, and engaging in self-reflection and positive self-talk to make up for mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I do not care

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete everything fully on time, it means I am an unreliable person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays busy to avoid making mistakes again

special_situations.event: Forgetting to return a phone call
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not done every small thing right, it means I am lazy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: After self-criticism, tries to soothe himself with positive self-talk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am lazy; I am unreliable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as responsible and reliable and to be recognized by others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as lazy and unreliable, thus being negated
defense_goal: Through harsh self-criticism and self-labeling, monitors and constrains themselves to reduce mistakes and maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.object_representation: Others as judges who criticize me and think I do not care

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In counseling, when talking about small mistakes made (such as being late, forgetting to send an email)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will see oneself as someone who does not care and is lazy (transference: internalizing the outside world's possible negative evaluations and projecting them onto the counselor/others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describing events in a self-blaming tone, repeating 'I am lazy / irresponsible', reducing exploration of external circumstances, emphasizing one's own faults.

manifestations: Intense self-judgment about 'responsibility/laziness', viewing punctuality and making no mistakes as the core of self-worth
Experiencing shame and self-denial after small mistakes, worrying about others' opinions

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Viewing 'must always be responsible, cannot be late or make mistakes' as an absolute standard
Evaluating oneself with labels like 'I am irresponsible' after small mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and self-denial, excessively focused on how others see oneself
Overly cautious in the face of small mistakes, decreased drive

positive_force: Close relationship with mother, receiving stable emotional support
Willing to proactively seek professional help and cooperate with recording and goal setting
Capable of self-reflection and aware of cognitive patterns
Has work and hobbies to maintain daily rhythm
negative_force: Overgeneralization and personalization of small mistakes, tending toward self-labeling
Overly concerned with others' evaluations; mind reading and mental filtering appear
Impaired self-esteem leading to decreased drive and lower daily efficiency
The rigid standard of 'perfect punctuality / making no mistakes'

target_behavior.behavior: Self-labeling and harsh self-blame after small mistakes, with low mood and decreased drive
antecedent: Late to last week's book club
Forgetting to send a work email
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalizing one mistake into an overall personality problem ('lazy / irresponsible'), and worrying about others' negative evaluations
target_behavior.function: Trying to reinforce self-monitoring and avoid repeating mistakes through self-criticism (negative reinforcement), while avoiding facing the uncertainty of mistakes and others' evaluations
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, low mood, insufficient motivation, affecting daily work and life
